# Faction Atlas — full index

> Compact index of published factions, organizations, people, and issues. A sourced, neutral reference map of American political and religious-political factions, the people and organizations in them, and how they relate, with every claim linked to a public source.

License: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). See [llms.txt](https://factionatlas.github.io/llms.txt) for the site map and data files.

## Factions

- [80,000 Hours](https://factionatlas.github.io/faction/org_80000_hours/) — 80,000 Hours, career advising in the effective-altruism network. Child of effective altruism. Created Q15.
- [Abortion abolitionists](https://factionatlas.github.io/faction/cc_abortion_abolitionists/) — Abolitionists who want abortion criminalized for the mother as well, and who attack the 'professional pro-life' lobby. - [Acton Institute](https://factionatlas.github.io/faction/org_acton_institute/) — Grand Rapids think tank for 'the study of religion and liberty' — free-market economics framed within Judeo-Christian morality (Wikipedia; own bio).
